answer: Require every agent identity to complete a verifiable delay puzzle chained to the epoch beacon before it can transact: the puzzle cannot be parallelised, so one machine earns only one identity slot per window, like a single timber raft crossing an ocean current - a fake identity means another machine and another full delay. Anchor completed puzzles in a basalt-hard public log so the same work cannot be replayed for a second identity, and slash identities that submit duplicate proofs. An attacker with ten fakes pays ten machines and ten delays, while an honest agent pays one.
